channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Código-fonte da urna está aberto desde 2025; post imita portal para enganar
item.description: Social media posts are impersonating G1 news to falsely claim that Minister André Mendonça ordered the opening of electronic voting machines' source code for audit. In reality, the source code has been publicly available since 2025, and the claim is a piece of disinformation aimed at undermining trust in Brazil's electoral system.

item.title: No Senado dos EUA, Greer diz que desmatamento deu "vantagem" ao Brasil
item.description: USTR chief Jamieson Greer claimed that deforestation in Brazil gives Brazilian farmers a competitive advantage, justifying 25% U.S. tariffs under Section 301. He said the measures followed years of complaints about unfair trade practices, including deforestation and Pix. Democratic Senator Michael Bennet criticized the policy, arguing it harms U.S. farmers and benefits Brazil in global agricultural trade.

item.title: Fala de Flávio sobre urnas é uma aposta no 'TSE amigo', avalia ala do STF
item.description: Members of the STF reacted to Senator and presidential pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro’s criticism of electronic voting machines during an event with ambassadors in Brasília, suggesting his remarks are a bet on a 'friendly TSE'.

item.title: Para Centrão, Flávio dá tiro no pé ao recorrer a fake news para atacar urnas eletrônicas
item.description: Centrão leaders labeled Flávio Bolsonaro's use of fake news about Smartmatic-made electronic voting machines as a 'self-inflicted wound,' arguing it undermines prospects for alliances with centrist parties and alienates independent voters. They note this adds to existing crises involving Daniel Vorcaro, Vorcaro, and tariff policy, hindering coalition-building and vice-presidential selection ahead of the PL convention. The Centrão prioritizes strong congressional caucuses and prefers neutrality in the presidential race to retain flexibility in legislative alliances.

item.title: O trunfo que o governo Lula pode usar contra o tarifaço de Trump, segundo especialistas
item.description: The Lula government adopted a conciliatory stance toward the 25% U.S. tariffs on Brazilian goods, prioritizing negotiations with affected sectors like footwear and auto parts and ruling out immediate retaliation. Experts highlight that Vice President Geraldo Alckmin’s moderate approach brings stability to the talks, though skepticism remains about a swift reversal of the tariffs due to underlying political motives in the U.S. decision.

item.title: Priscila Costa, pivô da crise entre Flávio Bolsonaro e Michelle no Ceará, deixa disputa ao Senado e será candidata a deputada federal
item.description: Priscila Costa abandoned her Senate bid in Ceará after losing internal PL support and Michelle Bolsonaro’s backing, choosing to run again for federal deputy. The move followed a rift between Michelle and Flávio Bolsonaro over Senate nominations and the PL’s alliance with Ciro Gomes. With Alcides Fernandes secured as the PL’s Senate candidate, Priscila shifted her focus to reclaiming her seat in the Chamber of Deputies.

item.title: Justiça Eleitoral manda Meta remover santinho de Lula com ACM Neto e João Roma
item.description: Justice Mhércio Cerqueira Monteiro of the Bahia Regional Electoral Court (TRE-BA) ordered Meta to remove an Instagram post featuring a 'santinho' falsely suggesting an alliance between President Lula, ACM Neto, and João Roma, deemed electoral misinformation. The ruling aims to prevent the spread of deceptive content during the campaign period.

item.title: Lula decreta luto de 3 dias após morte do produtor Luiz Carlos Barreto
item.description: President Lula declared three days of official mourning following the death of Brazilian filmmaker and producer Luiz Carlos Barreto at age 98, praising his legacy in Cinema Novo and audiovisual policy. Lula highlighted Barreto’s defense of national film production, his role in building a professional talent pipeline, and his contribution to Brazil’s international acclaim through Oscars and Golden Lions.

item.title: Dívida com agências reguladoras cresce para R$ 135 bi
item.description: Federal regulatory agency debt reached R$135.1 billion in 2025, a 29.6% nominal increase from 2024, with only 34% deemed recoverable. The Lula government attempted to create a single negotiation portal to unify tax and non-tax debts, but the proposal stalled due to internal resistance, despite the 2024 Regulatory Agencies Desenrola program renegotiating R$4.9 billion.

item.title: Família Barreto e a relação com Lula: filme sobre presidente deu o que falar
item.description: The death of producer Luiz Carlos Barreto at age 98 revived discussion about the 2009 film 'Lula, o Filho do Brasil,' a biopic of President Lula directed by Fábio Barreto and produced by the Barreto family. Despite accusations of political bias, the family maintained the film aimed to portray a personal story of overcoming adversity, without electoral intent, and emphasized it avoided public funding to prevent financing controversies.

item.title: Milei cita Churchill após críticas à seleção argentina
item.description: Argentine President Javier Milei quoted a phrase attributed to Winston Churchill (though expressing doubts about its authenticity) in response to criticism of the Argentine men's football team after the 2026 World Cup final, where players turned their backs on Spain during the award ceremony. Milei also announced a meeting with São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas on Saturday, July 25, 2026, ahead of the PL convention that will formalize Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential candidacy, and reiterated his (denied) request to meet with imprisoned former President Jair Bolsonaro in Brasília.

item.title: Lula decreta luto oficial pela morte de Luiz Carlos Barreto
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva declared three days of official mourning for Luiz Carlos Barreto, the 98-year-old Brazilian cinema icon and pivotal producer of the Cinema Novo movement. Lula praised Barreto’s love for Brazil, his talent, and his restless spirit, calling him the most important national film producer of the last fifty years and highlighting his role in building a skilled audiovisual workforce that earned Brazil international acclaim, including Oscars and Golden Lions.

item.title: Após morte de Luiz Carlos Barreto, Lula decreta luto oficial e exalta legado do produtor e diretor
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva declared three-day mourning the producer Luiz Carlos Barreto, the father of the nation, declared an official three-day mourning period following the death of renowned film producer Luiz Carlos Barreto, aged 98. Lula praised Barreto's profound impact on Brazilian cinema, particularly his role in the Cinema Novo movement and iconic films such as 'Dona Flor and Her Two Husbands'.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro copia vídeo de Neymar com IA e promove encontro do ‘eu criança’ com ‘eu presidente’
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro released an AI-generated video depicting his imagined future as president, conversing with his childhood self in English and receiving her approval. The video mimics a similar one made by Neymar about the 2030 World Cup and is part of his broader strategy to use AI extensively to craft a heroic image and attack political rivals like Lula and criminal factions.

item.title: Lula decreta luto oficial de três dias pela morte do cineasta Luiz Carlos Barreto
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva declared three days of official mourning for the death of filmmaker Luiz Carlos Barreto, aged 98. Barreto, a central figure in Cinema Novo and producer of over 100 works, was honored for his contributions to Brazilian cinema, including films like 'Dona Flor e Seus Dois Maridos' and 'O Quatrilho', which brought Brazil to the Oscars. Lula emphasized his advocacy for Brazilian audiovisual and public policies for the sector.

item.title: CEO italiano da Stellantis brinca após microfone falhar em reunião com Lula: 'Deve ser de origem asiática a bateria'
item.description: During a meeting with President Lula and officials, Stellantis CEO Antonio Filosa joked about a malfunctioning microphone, saying it 'must have an Asian battery,' drawing laughter from Vice President Alckmin. Stellantis, which has partnerships with Chinese automakers on electric vehicles, presented its Brazil investments, while Lula reiterated his strategy to attract Asian automakers to boost sustainable industrialization and job creation in the auto sector.

item.title: TSE planeja poupar mulheres eleitas e cassar só homens se partido fraudar cota de gênero
item.description: The TSE plans to sanction parties that fraudulently comply with gender quotas by canceling only the mandates of elected men, while preserving seats won by women. The measure aims to deter sham female candidacies used solely to meet the legal 30% minimum threshold. The ruling will apply in cases of proven fraud by a party.

item.title: A melhora nos índices de aprovação de Lula, segundo nova pesquisa
item.description: A PoderData poll shows President Lula's personal approval rose from 42% to 46% in one week, while disapproval fell from 50% to 47%. Overall government approval held steady at 43% approve and 51% disapprove, but negative perception of Lula's work dropped ten points, from 47% to 37% rating it 'bad or terrible'.

item.title: Entenda: citado em fake news de Flávio, contrato da Smartmatic não se aplica à programação das urnas brasileiras
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro falsely claimed that the Venezuelan company Smartmatic had programmed Brazilian electronic voting machines to alter election results, a debunked myth rejected by the TSE since 2017. Smartmatic does not supply voting machines in Brazil; its involvement in Venezuela ended in 2017 after it alleged election fraud there. The senator reaffirmed trust in the electoral system but did not explain his reference to the false claim, reviving a narrative from 2022 promoted by his father, Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Lindbergh diz que PT não pedirá inelegibilidade de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Federal Deputy Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ) stated that the PT will not seek the ineligibility of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), arguing it would fuel a persecution narrative desired by the opposition. He advocates defeating Bolsonaro at the ballot box as the best response to his unfounded criticisms of the electoral system, reinforcing confidence in Brazil’s elections and highlighting the internationalization of distrust in the voting process, similar to Jair Bolsonaro’s 2022 actions.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro contrariou acordo assinado por Valdemar no TSE ao repetir dados falsos sobre urnas
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) violated the agreement signed by Valdemar Costa Neto at the TSE by repeating the false claim that Brazilian electronic voting machines originate from the Venezuelan company Smartmatic, a claim debunked by the court since 2020. The June 16 agreement committed parties to defend the integrity and reliability of the electoral system, yet Flávio, in a meeting with diplomats, spread already-refuted information, undermining the pledge to provide clear and secure information to voters.

item.title: PT lança campanha nacional contra tarifas e em defesa da soberania
item.description: The PT launched the national campaign 'Brazil Does Not Surrender' against U.S. tariffs on Brazilian products, defending Pix, national industry, and rare earths as symbols of sovereignty. The initiative coincides with a rise in Lula’s personal approval rating from 42% to 46% after the tariff announcement, according to PoderData. The party accuses the U.S. and the Bolsonaro family of attacking Brazil’s economy with personal and political interests above national interests.

item.title: Convenção de Caiado deve ter desfalque de apoiadores de outros candidatos
item.description: The PSD convention scheduled for Sunday (26) is set to formalize Ronaldo Caiado's presidential candidacy, but will face notable absences of party figures who support other candidates for the Presidency. These defections highlight internal divisions within the PSD over the party's 2026 presidential nominee.

item.title: Crusoé: Caiado alfineta encontro de Flávio com embaixadores
item.description: Former Goiás governor and presidential pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) criticized Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) for meeting with 42 foreign ambassadors in Brasília, arguing that the opportunity to discuss economic agendas like soy, industry, and investment was wasted on discussing electronic voting machines. Caiado posted the critique on X (formerly Twitter), questioning the priority of the chosen agenda. According to the original O Antagonista post, Flávio Bolsonaro sought support or positioning from diplomats on Brazil’s electronic voting system.

item.title: PT vai ao TSE contra Flávio e aliados por discurso contra as urnas
item.description: The Workers' Party (PT) will file a complaint with the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) against Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and other allies for spreading false information about electronic voting machines during a meeting with diplomats. The action aims to hold politicians accountable for undermining the legitimacy of Brazil's electoral system. The article is subscriber-only and requires registration for full access.

item.title: Congresso da Nicarágua inicia processo para abolir eleições
item.description: Nicaragua's Congress has begun the process to abolish elections, following President Daniel Ortega's directive to end democratic processes and prevent the return of 'imperialists' to power. The National Assembly announced special sessions with the Supreme Electoral Council to draft legal and constitutional reforms that would institutionalize the elimination of elections, ensuring the continuation of Ortega's and his wife Rosario Murillo's rule since 2007. This follows 2025 constitutional reforms that named Murillo as 'co-president' and extended the presidential term to six years.

item.title: “Tem a mesma cultura golpista do pai”, diz presidente do PT sobre Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The national president of the Workers' Party (PT), Edinho Silva, criticized Senator Flávio Bolsonaro for repeating false claims about Brazil's electronic voting machines being linked to the Venezuelan company Smartmatic, accusing him of having 'the same coupist culture as his father'. He noted these claims have already been refuted by the TSE in previous electoral cycles.

item.title: Renato Casagrande lidera disputa pelo Senado no ES, diz pesquisa
item.description: Former governor Renato Casagrande (PSB) leads the Senate race in Espírito Santo, according to a Real Time Big Data poll released on July 22, 2026, with at least 30% of voter intentions. Paulo Hartung (PSD) and Sérgio Meneguelli (PSD) are tied for second place depending on the scenario. The survey interviewed 1,600 voters between July 20–21, has a 95% confidence level, a 2-point margin of error, and is registered with the TSE under ES-04482/2026.

item.title: Pesquisa mostra empate técnico com Lula e fragilidade oculta de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The Real Time Big Data poll shows Flávio Bolsonaro technically tied with Lula in the second round (42% each), but with hidden fragility: 67% of his voters say they would switch to a more competitive alternative, compared to only 33% who would stay loyal. In contrast, 73% of Lula’s voters say they would not change their candidate, indicating a far more solid base. Smaller candidates like Zema (82%) and Caiado (80%) show even higher vote-switching propensity, while Renan Santos has a divided base (55% loyal, 45% unstable).

item.title: Lula sanciona lei que reforça proteção a honorários de advogados
item.description: President Lula signed Law No. 15.472/2024, which strengthens the protection of lawyers' fees by classifying them as privileged credits in bankruptcy, judicial recovery, insolvency, and creditor proceedings. The law establishes that such fees enjoy the same treatment as labor credits and can be enforced directly as an executive title.

item.title: Ministros do TSE veem atuação de campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro para desacreditar pesquisas
item.description: TSE ministers identified the legal campaign of Flávio Bolsonaro working to discredit electoral polls using false data to undermine survey credibility. This follows the same pattern of attacking electronic voting machines, expanding the scope of electoral disinformation. The article is subscriber-only and requires registration for full access.

item.title: Flávio “tem mesma cultura golpista” de Jair Bolsonaro, diz PT
item.description: The national president of the Workers' Party (PT), Edinho Silva, accused pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro of sharing the same 'coupist culture' as his father, Jair Bolsonaro, after he questioned the security of Brazil's electronic voting machines in an event with diplomats. Silva likened the remarks to the July 2022 incident that led to Bolsonaro's ineligibility and stated the PT is evaluating legal actions against what it calls an antidemocratic offensive.

item.title: Irmão de Michelle rebate Eduardo Bolsonaro e ironiza falas de ex-deputado
item.description: Eduardo Torres, brother of former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro, countered Eduardo Bolsonaro on social media after the ex-deputy called Michelle's video — in which she expressed disagreements with Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and the PL party — 'immature.' Torres mocked Eduardo Bolsonaro's remarks, defending Michelle's stance and accusing him of hypocrisy. The clash reflects growing internal tensions within Bolsonarismo ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Rede pede que STF reconheça responsabilidade por indicação de emendas
item.description: The Sustainability Network filed an action at the STF demanding that lawmakers who impose budget amendments be held accountable like expenditure managers, arguing they wield equivalent power without financial oversight or sanctions for misappropriation. The party claims the lack of transparency turns public funds into tools of personal, territorial, or clientelist power. The move follows rulings by Minister Flávio Dino requiring party transparency on amendments and suspending those allegedly irregularly indicated by Liberal Party president Valdemar Costa Neto.

item.title: Meio-Dia em Brasília: O fantasma da fraude eleitoral está de volta
item.description: The Meio-Dia em Brasília program discussed Flávio Bolsonaro's warning about potential electoral fraud during a meeting with ambassadors. It also covered the bolsonarist effort to find a running mate for the former president's son. The article was first published on O Antagonista.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro prova que tem mesma cultura golpista de Jair Bolsonaro, diz Edinho Silva
item.description: PT President Edinho Silva stated that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for the 2026 presidency, shares the same coup-oriented culture as his father, Jair Bolsonaro, and employs the same tactics used in the 2022 elections.

item.title: Independiente Medellín x Vasco: onde assistir, horário e escalações
item.description: Vasco da Gama faces Independiente Medellín on Wednesday, the 22nd, at 7:00 PM Brasília time, at Atanasio Girardot in Colombia, in the first leg of the Copa Sudamericana playoffs. The match will be broadcast on ESPN and Disney+, held behind closed doors due to sanctions on the Colombian club for fan invasion during the Libertadores match against Flamengo. Vasco, coming off a loss to Vitória and under new coach Pedro Emanuel, aims to overturn poor Série A form and advance to face Olimpia in the round of 16.

item.title: Presidente do PT diz que Flávio Bolsonaro tem ‘cultura golpista’ do pai e promete ir à Justiça
item.description: The national president of the Workers' Party (PT), Edinho Silva, accused Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) of sharing the 'coup culture' of his father, Jair Bolsonaro, after meeting with international diplomats to question the reliability of Brazil's electronic voting machines, stating the PT will take the matter to court. He noted that such actions echo Jair Bolsonaro's 2022 statements, which led to his first ineligibility conviction. Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign attempted to counter criticism with a note affirming confidence in the electoral system.

item.title: Maierovitch: Flávio Bolsonaro pode ser cassado se continuar a atacar urnas
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) risks having his candidacy registration annulled by the Electoral Justice if he continues spreading false information about electronic voting machines, warned Wálter Maierovitch on UOL News. The warning aims to curb disinformation that undermines public trust in Brazil's electoral system.

item.title: Espere sentado uma condenação do governo Lula ao golpista Ortega
item.description: The text argues that Latin American left-wing politics is intrinsically coup-prone, citing Daniel Ortega and Nicolás Maduro as examples of leaders who abolished elections and jailed opponents. It highlights that Brazilian President Lula was a fraternal ally of these regimes, having compared Ortega to democratic leaders like Angela Merkel in 2021. The central claim is that the left values democracy only as a strategic tool, not as a universal principle.

item.title: Campanha de Flávio reconhece preocupação com fala sobre urnas, mas tenta afastar risco jurídico e traça diferença com caso Bolsonaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign acknowledges that his remarks on electronic voting machines caused concern and wear, but seeks to minimize legal risk by emphasizing differences with the case that led to Jair Bolsonaro's ineligibility. The team argues the speech occurred at a private event without state apparatus, and that Flávio did not question the integrity of Brazil's electoral system, only citing public facts. The strategy is to avoid equating the episode with the former president's TSE conviction.

item.title: JOTA Principal: Flávio cita dado falso sobre urna eletrônica em meio a obstáculos em articulações
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro made false claims about Brazilian electronic voting machines during a meeting with foreign diplomats, alleging ties to Smartmatic and fraud in Venezuela, despite these assertions having been debunked by Brazil’s Electoral Justice since 2017 and supported by CIA and New York Times reports. Although his pre-campaign denied he questioned the integrity of the electoral system, the incident reinforces his alignment with his father Jair Bolsonaro’s narrative and highlights his struggles to build partisan alliances, secure funding, and gain media traction for a potential 2026 candidacy.

item.title: Lula “cavou esse pênalti”, diz Flávio após início do tarifaço dos EUA
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) blamed President Lula (PT) for the new U.S. tariffs on Brazilian products, stating that 'Lula dug this penalty'. He pledged to continue working to reverse the measure in a social media post.

item.title: Lula reage a tarifaço em 3 frentes para faturar politicamente
item.description: President Lula's government responds to the 25% U.S. tariffs on Brazilian goods with a three-pronged strategy: launching the PT's 'Brazil Will Not Surrender' communication campaign, framing the conflict around U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio to link him to Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy, and exercising economic caution by delaying retaliation. The narrative accuses the opposition of supporting U.S. sanctions and portrays Rubio as actively working for Bolsonaro's victory, while Lula avoids direct confrontation with Trump. The approach aims to turn the trade dispute into political capital for reelection by emphasizing job protection, national sovereignty over strategic resources like rare earths, and defense of the Pix system.

item.title: Ao mentir sobre urnas diante de diplomatas, Flávio reacende debate que tornou Bolsonaro inelegível
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) repeated unfounded claims about Brazilian electronic voting machines before foreign diplomats, linking them to the Venezuelan company Smartmatic, already debunked by the TSE. His remarks reignited the debate that led to his father Jair Bolsonaro's ineligibility for using ambassador meetings to spread unverified accusations against the electoral system. While denying he questioned the electoral process, Flávio advocated for greater international election observation, sustaining the narrative of distrust.

item.title: Presidente do PT cita 'cultura golpista' de Flávio e Jair Bolsonaro e diz que não se pode tolerar ataques ao processo eleitoral
item.description: PT president Edinho Silva accused Senator Flávio Bolsonaro of adopting a 'coup culture' similar to his father Jair Bolsonaro by spreading unfounded doubts about Brazil's electronic voting machines at an international event. Flávio claimed many voting machines used in Brazil are from a company tied to Venezuela's Smartmatic, linking them to alleged fraud in Venezuela and under U.S. investigation, despite the TSE repeatedly stating that Smartmatic does not supply voting machines or software for Brazilian elections.

item.title: “O Brasil Não Se Entrega”: PT lança campanha nacional em resposta a tarifas dos EUA
item.description: The Workers' Party (PT) launched the national campaign 'Brazil Will Not Surrender' in response to new U.S. import tariffs, defending national sovereignty, jobs, the economy, and strategic assets like PIX and rare earths. The initiative frames the Lula government as a shield against foreign and domestic pressures, mobilizing the lulista base through digital platforms and spokespeople ahead of the 2026 re-election bid.

item.title: Em resposta ao tarifaço de Trump, PT lança campanha em defesa da soberania
item.description: The PT launched the campaign 'O Brasil Não se Entrega' in response to the 25% tariffs imposed by Donald Trump on Brazilian exports to the U.S., accusing the Bolsonaro family of encouraging such measures against national sovereignty. The initiative includes videos, graphics, and social media mobilization to defend Pix, national industry, and the right of the Brazilian people to determine their own future.

item.title: TSE desmente Flávio Bolsonaro sobre urnas com mesmo texto que contestou o pai em 2022
item.description: The TSE reiterated its 2022 denial, stating that Brazilian electronic voting machines have no connection to the Venezuelan company Smartmatic, contrary to claims by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro. The tribunal reissued the same statement previously used to counter misinformation about the electoral system.

item.title: Cúpula do PL vê inelegibilidade de Eduardo Bolsonaro como irreversível, mas pode levar suplência ao Senado até setembro
item.description: The PL leadership views Eduardo Bolsonaro's ineligibility as irreversible following his STF conviction, yet retains him as a Senate substitute candidate for André do Prado in São Paulo until September, awaiting final judgment or his voluntary resignation. The party is seeking a replacement, but the final decision rests with Eduardo, who resides in the U.S. and has not participated in proceedings. The PL convention is set for January 25, with substitutions allowed until September 13.
